verdict.rationale: Browserbase's first-party docs describe an SDK with "natural language selectors" and agents, defined by a natural-language goal, that pull data from websites. That covers natural-language instructions in place of hand-written selectors. However, no evidence shows a dedicated structured-extraction call that returns schema-typed data. The URL-to-JSON fetch is a format conversion, not instruction-driven extraction. Missing for 10: a documented extract API with schema-defined structured output, examples of natural-language extraction instructions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of extraction quality.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from a page using natural language instructions instead of writing selectors

citations.quote: Natural language selectors, self-healing actions, and caching at scale.
Your agent logs in, navigates, and pulls data from any website, login walls included.
Create your Browserbase Agent from the dashboard by describing the goal in natural language.
